findings.description: `endSandboxRun` only waits its 200 ms when `liveChildren` is non-empty. A straggler that `settle` SIGKILLs is untracked straight away, so its in-flight write can still land after `endSandboxRun` removes the scratch dir without waiting.

Exporting `TOOLCHAIN_CACHE_DIRNAME` lets the new test helper and `fakeCheckout` rebuild the cache path themselves. That copies the layout the private `toolchainCacheDir` owns (sandbox.utils.ts:567-572, `projectId(resolvePath(repoPath))` under `join(resolvePath(tmpdir()), TOOLCHAIN_CACHE_DIRNAME)`). A change to the layout or the key now means editing three files (Shotgun Surgery). The copies have already drifted: `fakeCheckout` keys on the unresolved `mkdtempSync(homedir()…)` path, while production resolves it first.

For the HOME branch, the change rewrites `fakeCheckout` to repeat `tempDir`'s whole cleanup: compute the cache path, register `onTestFinished`, remove the dir and the cache. Only the base directory differs. The two copies already differ (`maxRetries: 3` and a resolved key in `tempDir`, neither in the copy). Letting `tempDir` take an optional base directory (`tempDir(prefix, base = tmpdir())`) would remove the copy, so the cleanup a test needs lives in one place.

The same `afterAll(() => { endSandboxRun(); })` block and its 3-line decision-100 comment are pasted into six test files (custom-adapter, python-adapter, cli/index, audit, init, land); since `endSandboxRun` is a no-op without a run, one vitest `setupFiles` entry (or a shared export in src/test/) would replace them and cover future files.

The new afterAll(endSandboxRun) block was inserted under the existing describe-header comment, so "Real git repos, a bare origin and a sandboxed audit per test." now runs into the decision-100 comment and sits over the afterAll instead of over describe('landSession'); the new `endSandboxRun` import at line 6 also sits above the vi.mock calls, outside the project-import group.

The "Prefer the real dependency" section of testing.md still teaches `realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'pup-test-')))`, while decision 100 makes `tempDir(prefix)` the one way a test makes a temp directory; new tests that follow the convention doc will leak again.

The parenthetical added to `withScratchGitDir`'s JSDoc is spliced mid-sentence (two colons in one sentence) and restates `removeGateDir`'s own JSDoc (reports, never throws: decision 95), which AGENTS.md's comment rule calls a duplicate; drop it or give it its own sentence.

Decision 100 says `endSandboxRun` first SIGKILLs every live child's group and then waits 200 ms, but in the code the kill and the wait both sit inside `if (liveChildren.size > 0)`; say "if any child is live".

The new finally comment "…and before this process goes on to anything else (decision 100)" is vague and carries no why; the real reason (a vitest worker or the long-lived conductor never emits `exit`) is what a reader needs, or a bare pointer to `endSandboxRun`'s JSDoc.

The describe comment "The scratch TMPDIR went with the process, which a test worker… outlives or leaves without an `exit`" describes the old behaviour in past tense; state the invariant under test instead (a gate removes its scratch TMPDIR itself, because a test worker or the conductor never emits `exit`).
